pack.name: The Glitter Spire
pack.summary: The record example. One run raises a glitter-tech spire; left to overload, it burns the valley to glass and ends the run. The next run builds on its ruins: hoverbikes salvaged from the spire carry your knights.

tags.meaning: Strange bright machines of glass and wire stand here.
Something here can carry a rider. An ingredient of a unit: a knight is a soldier with a mount.
It runs on glitter power. An ingredient of a unit.

things.name: Glitter spire
things.text: A spire of glass and wire that hums day and night.
things.art: A tall spire of glass and copper wire humming over an old stone tower, painterly.

things.name: Hoverbikes
things.text: Saddles of glass that float a hand above the ground. Your knights ride them.
things.art: Knights in old plate riding floating glass saddles across a yard, painterly.

cards.title: Raise the glitter spire
cards.pitch: I found plans for a spire of glass and wire in the tower cellar. Let me build it.

if_taken.say: The spire rises over the old tower, humming.

cards.art: A tinker unrolling glowing plans on a cellar table, painterly.

cards.title: The spire hums too loud
cards.pitch: The spire is drinking too much light. Vent it now or it will burn the valley to glass.

if_taken.say: The spire is vented. It hums softly again.

if_expires.name: The glitter spire burned the valley to glass

if_expires.say: White light. The tower is glass, and every far town is empty.

cards.art: A spire of glass blazing white over a town at night, painterly.

cards.title: Salvage the glass saddles
cards.pitch: There are glass saddles in the ruins of the spire. They float. Give me a worker and I will drag them out.
cards.hint: Glass saddles lie in a ruin nobody has made yet.

if_taken.say: Three glass saddles hang in the wagon yard, a hand above the ground.

if_expires.say: The scavenger sells the saddles down the river.

cards.art: A scavenger hauling a floating glass saddle out of blackened ruins, painterly.

cards.title: Glass-seekers at the gate
cards.pitch: Pilgrims have come to see where the glitter spire stood. They will pay to camp here.

if_taken.say: The pilgrims pay in copper and glass.

cards.art: Travellers with glass beads at a town gate, painterly.

rules.name: Knights on glass saddles
rules.why: {b} carry your soldiers over the walls: +{n} Might
